title: Story log: seeded chance on old builds, four tries to walk in
body:
The last curated photo (5f0f9e7, the Oct 18 slideshow) worked locally but missed in CI. A neighbor, Bill, had wandered in front of the lemon, so pressing {A} talked to him. Builds from before `?seed=` move their neighbors at random, so this changed from run to run.

- On a build without the game clock, the camera now seeds `Math.random` before the page's own scripts run. That makes old-build photos repeatable too.
- Walking in gets up to four tries, each with a new seed. The record says `got in on try N` when it took more than one.

Tested on the real 5f0f9e7 build: it got in on try 2 and on try 3 across two runs. Ham on #62 got in first time. 473 tests pass.

## Story

Idea: Make the walk-in photos on old builds reliable.
Where: none
Tags: story-log
Asked vs made: A follow-up to the inside-photos work, so the last curated change gets its photo.
